summary: Iteration 12 backend validation: Themes (10), BestWord Styles follow/unfollow/status, Zone-filtered feed (theme + source=styles), Trends (public, scope/period/theme), and Stripe invoicing endpoint. 24/24 pytest cases passed. Frontend landing renders cleanly (no red screen, bundle compiles). Mock Stripe path returns available:false with PT message; non-mock fake sid returns 502 (route reachable + handled). minor.issue: Line 1430: invoice_data.description references undefined variable `word` (NameError at runtime when renew is invoked with a real Stripe key). Currently dead code in mock mode but will 500 in real test mode. Use original['word'] like the rest of the function.
